title: Rational $\mathbf{Θ_n}$-Inner Function and its Application in Interpolation Problem
summary: In this paper, we investigate several geometric and function-theoretic properties of the domain $\mathbfΘ_n$. We obtain new characterizations of its distinguished boundary and introduce the notion of a \textit{$\mathbfΘ_n$-inner function}, together with several illustrative examples. We establish connections between $\mathbfΘn$-inner functions and $Γ_n$-inner functions, tetra-inner functions, and $\mathbfΘ_{n+1}$-inner functions.
